agencies.title: For agencies
agencies.description: Automation agencies: your clients' agents spend under control, with a budget and an invoice for each client.
agencies.headline: Your clients' agents spend. You rebill without the hassle.
agencies.lead: Do you build n8n, Make or Claude agents for your clients? Artemis separates spending by client, applies a budget to each one and prepares the rebilling with your margin.

spaces.title: One workspace per client
spaces.body: Assign each agent to a client. Its requests, cards, transactions and receipts are kept separate. An agent can never spend another client's budget.

budget.title: A monthly budget per client
budget.body: Set a monthly cap for each client, on top of each agent's rules. Beyond it, the request is rejected before it even reaches a human.

rebilling.title: Rebilling in one click
rebilling.body: Every month, Artemis prepares a report for each client: purchases charged, agent, merchant, receipt, management fee based on your margin, total to rebill. CSV export ready to send or to import into your invoicing tool.

proof.title: Proof for your clients
proof.body: Every payment is signed by an authorized person, and the log cannot be altered. Show your clients that their agents are under human oversight, as the AI Act requires.

european.title: European, end to end
european.body: Euros, European banks, data in Frankfurt, FEC and Pennylane exports for French accounting.
